name: Glenden Wood
summary: Glenden Wood is an Aluvian town nestled in the Tiofor Woods west of Cragstone, invaded by King Varicci's New Viamont army in 16 PY and still under a wary siege. In the world it is a clearing in a forest bowl (z 50) ringed by 25-35 m pines and broadleaf trees and dominated by a single giant tree 58 m tall beside the Life Stone; mossy stone cottages, a brick hall on a raised mound with a Viamontian siege tent and glowing lanterns, a well, the Banderling statue on its plinth and the Town Network portal fill the clearing, and forest roads climb out west and north. Noon light falls straight into the bowl; foliage pollen and leaves drift in every shot.

shots.standingOrder: Drift slowly in over the northern road and look down into the forest bowl of Glenden Wood; stay 8 m above every tree top.
shots.notes: Establishing: from 46 m above the north road (z 105) the camera drifts 8 deg and pushes 10 % toward the town, looking down into the forest bowl of Glenden Wood (z 50) ringed by 25-60 m trees, the giant tree and the cottages in the clearing. Noon light from high east. Clearance: 24.6 m to the nearest crown, >= 18 m above every tree top in view; line of sight to the town centre clear in all samples.

shots.standingOrder: Walk east along the forest road into Glenden Wood at an easy pace with the Life Stone and the giant trees ahead; keep to the road, 4 m from every trunk.
shots.notes: POV walk-in: eye height 1.66 m on the west forest road (z 50, flat), walking 22 m east at an easy pace with a light step bob; the Life Stone sparkles right of centre (NDC x 0.33->0.60) and the giant tree's canopy fills the upper frame (NDC y 0.5->0.8); foliage pollen/leaves catch the noon light. Clearance: passes 2.7 m from a 2.3 m bush and >= 4.6 m from every trunk; query-radius 4 m = 0 statics.

shots.standingOrder: Start on the forest canopy above the cottages and tilt down slowly onto the blue swirl of the Town Network portal; hold position 10 m from the portal.
shots.notes: Particle detail: locked position 14 m east of the Town Network portal (open lawn, sun behind), tilting from 42 deg above the portal (the canopy of a 33 m tree and the cottage roofs against the sky) down onto the blue swirl. Clearance: 3.2 m from a signpost that stays out of frame (60 deg off-axis), no other static within 4 m. Note: the opt-in retail scenery bake would place a pine at this spot; the default bake (what renders) is clear.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral slowly up and around the giant tree of Glenden Wood with the town bowl behind it; stay 8 m above every tree top and 20 m from the giant crown.
shots.notes: Hero aerial: helix 0.28 turn clockwise around the 58 m giant tree from SW to N, radius 36->50 m, rising z 100->132, the town clearing beside it. Clearance: >= 14 m above the default-bake pine tops (<= 86), 19.7 m to the nearest crown, 30+ m from the giant crown; vmax 8.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the town square and rise vertically out of the forest bowl while turning slowly; stay 15 m from every crown.
shots.notes: Closing top-down: straight down on the town square at noon (short shadows), rising 16->82 m above it while turning 60 deg; roofs, wells, the siege tent and canopy rings become a pattern. Clearance: 17 m horizontally from the nearest crown (top 83) at the lowest point; vmax 7.4 m/s.
